definitions.explanation: A form of entertainment where people sing along to recorded music using a microphone, with lyrics displayed on a screen. Also refers to karaoke establishments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧カラオケ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to karaoke with friends.
What will you sing at karaoke?

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧カラオケ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}だ→上手：00707_jouzu⟧。

notes:
The word カラオケ comes from ⟦{空|から}→空：27640_kara⟧ (empty) + ⟦オーケストラ→オーケストラ：04466_ookesutora⟧ (orchestra), meaning "empty orchestra" - music without the vocal track.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カラオケ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go to karaoke)
- カラオケ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧ (to sing at karaoke)
- ⟦カラオケボックス→カラオケボックス：noentry⟧ (karaoke booth/room)
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧カラオケ/⟦ヒトカラ→ヒトカラ：noentry⟧ (solo karaoke)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Karaoke originated in Japan in the 1970s and has become a major entertainment industry worldwide.
- Japanese karaoke establishments typically have private rooms (カラオケ⟦ボックス→ボックス：30522_bokkusu⟧) rather than public stages.
